metadata.scope: depth-13/14 registry IDs under the R3 finite quotient

played_continuation_ordering_hints.claim: MEASURED ordering-only heuristic; not a certificate, verdict, or pruning rule
played_continuation_ordering_hints.safe_use: Move the matching action to the front of A1 ordering only; search all other actions normally if it fails.

d1_legal_pair_generator.predicate: L1(x) and (L1(y) or dist(x,y)<=8), or symmetrically
d1_legal_pair_generator.L1: root_legal(cell) or within radius 8 of either A1 placement
d1_legal_pair_generator.protocol_requirement: root_legal flags, quotient-cell coordinates, and A1; root occupied coordinates are not required

empty_and_singleton_projection.claim: PROOF-SKETCH relative to the R3 interaction normalization
empty_and_singleton_projection.statement: D1 turns with zero/one retained effects are represented by EMPTY/singleton actions; the omitted filler changes no retained window, and after quota pruning every future retained action is already legal without that filler
empty_and_singleton_projection.initially_illegal_fringe: Such a cell is in neither an A1-seeded/anchored attacker window nor an anchored defender window. Alone it can touch only pristine six-empty defender-near windows, leaving residual five with only four D placements left, so its retained effect is EMPTY.

later_stage_legality.statement: After D1, every retained A window contains a root/A1 A stone. A retained D-near window has residual at most four, so both D1 stones lie in it; anchored D windows contain a root D stone. Every residual cell is therefore within hex distance five of an occupied stone. The invariant persists through A2, D2, A3, the D3 cover, and the final A completion.
later_stage_legality.consequence: Incidence-twin action quotienting is legality-safe from A2 onward, but not at D1 unless classes carry a legal physical-pair witness.
